verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS spend platform like Brex, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out. The pack covers only APIs, product features, the MCP server and unrelated community sentiment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
